endpoints.rateLimitCachePolicy: 30-minute in-memory feed cache, OkHttp connect/read/write timeouts, and degraded-source cooldown after repeated failures

endpoints.surface: Signed TikTok clip links for preview playback, duration probes, and sound extraction
endpoints.authLocation: signed link returned by the embed page

endpoints.mediaCached: preview bytes use the shared audio preview cache; after apply or download only the extracted .m4a sound track stays in app cache, capped at 12 files
endpoints.rateLimitCachePolicy: four duration probes at a time, and one fresh-link retry per expired download

endpoints.dataSent: none by app-initiated network; links are parsed as import locators

endpoints.surface: Opt-in check for a newer published Aura release
endpoints.dataSent: one GET for the latest release of SysAdminDoc/Aura with Aura's version in the User-Agent; no account, device, or install identifier
endpoints.mediaCached: no media; the newest version's number, notes, and release page link are kept in app preferences until it is installed or the check is turned off
endpoints.rateLimitCachePolicy: at most one automatic request a day and one try per app start, skipped on metered networks and with Data Saver on; a 403 or 429 is reported and not retried
endpoints.fallbackBehavior: a failed check changes nothing and reports the reason in Settings; github.com is only opened in the browser when the user taps the release page link
